summary: Move dispatch-browser-multiprocess's postgres service in .github/workflows/envoy-and-contracts.yaml from the pgvector 0.8.7-pg16 digest (7b822b0a…, line 1094) to the pg18 digest every other job pins (2358fcba…, line 975); the service mounts no data directory, so nothing else in it changes. Because the job's `dispatch` paths filter omits the workflow file, a PR changing only that line skips the job (PR #2476's head shows it skipped), so the plan adds a filter `dispatch_browser_multiprocess` = the workflow file + the anchored `dispatch` list and gates the job on it.

specDepartures.plan: Also adds a paths filter `dispatch_browser_multiprocess` (the workflow file plus the anchored `dispatch` list), its `changes` output, and gates the job on it, with the comments that describe the filters kept true.
specDepartures.evidence: The job is gated `if: needs.changes.outputs.dispatch == 'true'` (envoy-and-contracts.yaml:1090) and the `dispatch` filter (lines 645-700) omits the workflow file; PR #2476, which changed only workflows and docs, shows `dispatch-browser-multiprocess skipped` on its head. Without a gate change the job cannot pass on the PR (acceptance line 2) nor run on main after the merge.
